items.title: How Decagon uses AI for design system saturation
items.excerpt: Decagon uses Figma MCP to keep design specs and code in continuous alignment so AI coding agents can pull straight from the component library, and Figma Make to spin up multiple dashboard variants for customer feedback before committing engineering time — a concrete look at scaling a design system with AI in the loop.

items.title: How to Lead Design Teams Through the AI Era
items.excerpt: Design leader Jen Dunnam (ex-Patreon, Shopify) shares how she steadies teams amid constant AI-driven change — breaking problems down, rethinking what 'speed' means in design ops, choosing the right tools, and sharpening principles rather than chasing every new model.

items.title: The Economist shades AI in sharp new billboard ads
items.excerpt: Cocogun's new billboard campaign for The Economist leans on stripped-back, human-made visuals to position editorial craft against AI-generated sameness — a signal of how design and advertising teams are branding around (and against) generative AI.

items.title: You can now deploy Lovable apps to Vercel
items.excerpt: Vercel added one-click deployment for apps built in Lovable, closing the loop from AI prompt-to-app to production hosting — another step in the design-to-code pipeline where non-engineers ship real software from a conversational builder.

items.title: Cursor 3.11: Side Chats and Conversation Search
items.excerpt: Cursor 3.11 adds side chats for parallel agent conversations plus a local search index across thousands of past agent transcripts — quality-of-life upgrades for designers and builders running multiple AI coding threads in the visual-editor workflow.
